identity.description: PitchBook provides private capital market data, research and tools (companies, deals, investors, funds) for investment professionals.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe the PitchBook platform; no developer docs or API pages were provided.

access.production_restrictions: Pricing is by request via a sales form; Direct Data and CRM Integration are premium offerings. A free trial is only offered at PitchBook's discretion.

api.limitations: Sources do not document a public API; Direct Data is only mentioned as a premium offering.
